agent.title: Your agent
agent.subtitle: How your assistant introduces itself and what it can do for your customers.
field.businessName.label: Business name
field.businessName.help: Used when the agent introduces itself.
field.purpose.label: What your agent is here to do
field.purpose.help: Describe it in your own words, as you would to a new receptionist.
field.purpose.placeholder: Help customers book appointments and answer questions about our services.
field.tone.label: Tone of voice
field.tone.help: How your agent sounds to customers.
field.timezone.label: Time zone
field.timezone.help: Used for opening hours and appointment times.
field.uiLocale.label: Dashboard language
field.uiLocale.help: The language of these screens. Only changes what you see here.
hours.title: Opening hours
hours.help: Your agent won't offer appointments outside these hours.
capabilities.title: What your agent can do
capabilities.help: Switch on the things your agent should handle for customers.
capabilities.needsSetup: Collects the details; your team confirms manually.
field.replyLanguage.label: Language the agent replies in
field.replyLanguage.help: Your agent understands both Urdu and English, and callers can mix them. It always replies in the language you choose here.
knowledge.title: Knowledge
knowledge.help: What your agent answers from. Upload documents or write them here.
knowledge.empty: No documents yet. Add one so your agent has something to answer from.
knowledge.uploadHelp: Accepted: {types}. Up to {max} MB. Scanned images are not readable.
knowledge.docNameHelp: Reusing a name replaces that document instead of adding a second copy.
knowledge.replaced: Replaced — the old version is gone.
knowledge.confirmDelete: Delete this document? Your agent will stop using it immediately.
knowledge.confirmReplace: {titles} already exists and will be replaced with this new version. Continue?
knowledge.confirmDeleteMany: Delete {count} documents? Your agent will stop using them immediately.
knowledge.crawlHelp: We read the pages and turn them into knowledge. Only public websites; re-adding the same site replaces it.
jobs.title: Importing
jobs.scannedNote: Scanned document — reading the text from the images. This takes longer.
knowledge.uploadMany: You can select several files at once.
knowledge.notEditable: Uploaded files cannot be edited here. Upload a corrected version to replace it.
chat.empty: Ask a question to test your agent.
chat.disclaimer: Internal test surface — the same agent a phone call will reach.
chat.noSources: No matching document — answered from persona only
chat.searchRewriteFailed: Couldn't rewrite the question — searched it as typed
chat.searchRewriteSkipped: Question rewriting is paused after repeated failures — searched it as typed
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.quotaExceeded: The AI service is at its usage limit for now. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.unavailable: We couldn't reach the AI service right now. Please try again shortly.
voice.help: Call your agent from this browser: press Call, allow the microphone, and talk. It answers from the same knowledge and settings as a real phone call.
voice.headphonesHint: Tip: use headphones. Without them the agent can hear itself through your speakers and may stop talking.
voice.intent.question: Question
voice.log.title: Call timeline
voice.endReason.idle_timeout: no one spoke for a while
voice.endReason.setup_failed: the call could not be set up
voice.history.title: Recent calls
voice.history.noTurns: Nothing was said in this call.
voice.error.micDenied: Microphone access was blocked. Allow it in your browser's address bar and try again.
voice.error.micUnavailable: No microphone could be opened on this device.
voice.error.refused: The call could not be started.
voice.error.rateLimited: Too many calls started in a short time. Please wait a minute.
voice.error.gatewayOffline: The voice server isn't running. Start it with “npm run voice”.
voice.error.gatewayLoading: The voice server is still loading its speech models. Try again in a few seconds.
voice.error.gatewayError: The voice server couldn't load its speech models. Run “npm run voice:models”, then restart it.
voice.error.bad_ticket: The call was refused. Please try again.
voice.error.busy: The voice server is at capacity. Please try again shortly.
voice.error.tenant_busy: This business already has the maximum number of calls in progress.
voice.error.not_ready: The voice server is still loading its speech models. Try again in a few seconds.
voice.error.internal: The call could not be set up. Please try again.
voice.error.turnFailed: The agent couldn't answer that last question (the AI service may be at its limit). It apologised and is still listening.
voice.picker.title: Voice
voice.picker.help: How your agent sounds on calls. Pick a voice for each language it may speak, and listen before you save.
voice.picker.tierHelp: Natural voices sound the most human but take about a second longer to start speaking on this server. Fast voices answer sooner but sound more synthetic.
voice.picker.previewError.offline: Start the voice server (npm run voice) to listen to voices.
voice.picker.previewError.failed: That voice could not be played. Is the voice server running and has it finished loading?
voice.picker.urduSttMissing: Your agent understands Urdu callers only with Urdu speech recognition, which needs a free Groq key (GROQ_API_KEY) on the voice server. Until then it can only understand English speech.
collect.title: What your agent collects
collect.help: Choose which details your agent asks for when a customer wants an appointment or a callback. It checks every answer, reads everything back, and saves a request that your team confirms. The agent never books or confirms anything itself.
collect.enableHelp: Off: your agent only answers questions.
collect.industry.label: Type of business
collect.industry.help: Starts you off with the details that usually matter for this kind of business. You can change everything afterwards.
collect.industry.confirm: Replace the current choices with the “{industry}” setup? Your lists and your own details are kept.
collect.fields.title: What to ask, in this order
collect.fields.empty: Nothing yet. Add a detail below.
collect.fields.sensitive: Sensitive — only ask for it if you really need it
collect.fields.wordingHelp: Leave empty to use the standard question.
collect.fields.tooMany: That is a lot of questions for a phone call; callers tend to give up after about {max}.
collect.preview.title: How your agent will ask
collect.services.title: Services
collect.services.help: The list a customer chooses from. One per line; add the Urdu name after a | if you like.
collect.services.placeholder:
Checkup | معائنہ
Root canal | روٹ کینال
collect.staff.title: Doctors or staff
collect.staff.help: The people a customer can ask for. One per line; add the Urdu name after a | if you like.
collect.custom.title: Your own details
collect.custom.help: Something specific to your business that is not in the list.
records.title: Requests taken
records.help: What customers asked for. Your team confirms each one; until then it is only a request.
records.updateFailed: That could not be changed. Reload and try again.
handoff.title: Call forwarding to a person
handoff.help: When the agent cannot help, or the caller asks for a person, it can pass the call to someone on your team. It always tells the caller first.
handoff.enable: Forward callers to a person when needed
handoff.enableHelp: Off by default. Switch it on only after adding at least one person below.
handoff.contactsHelp: Tried in this order. If the first person does not answer, the next one is tried. Add a role (for example Senior doctor), a name, and a phone number.
handoff.name: Name
handoff.whenCallerAsks: Forward at once when the caller asks to speak to a person
handoff.afterMisses.label: When the agent cannot understand or help, forward after
handoff.afterMisses.help: The first time, the agent says it did not understand and asks the caller to say it another way. It forwards on the last chosen time.
handoff.outsideHours.label: Outside your opening hours
handoff.outsideHours.callback: Offer to take a call-back request
handoff.outsideHours.help: Uses the opening hours saved for your business.
handoff.topics.label: Always forward these topics (optional)
handoff.topics.help: Separate with commas. If a caller says one of these words, the call is forwarded.
voice.endReason.transferred: the call was passed to a person
voice.transfer.simulated: Simulated: this test console has no phone line, so nobody is actually called.
agents.label: Agent
agents.help: Each agent has its own settings, checklist, call forwarding, calls and requests. In Knowledge, choose which documents each agent answers from — shared documents are used by every agent.
agents.copyHelp: The new agent starts with a copy of the settings of "{name}". You can change everything afterwards.
agents.created: Agent created. You are now editing it.
agents.archiveConfirm: Archive "{name}"? It will stop answering, but its calls and requests stay.
agents.archivedHelp: This agent is archived: it does not answer chats or calls. Restore it to use it again.
knowledgeAgents.help: An agent answers only from the documents it can use. Changing this does not re-read the document.
knowledgeAgents.unknownAgent: an agent that no longer exists
knowledgeAgents.newForHelp: Applies to uploads, written documents and websites. With "All agents", a document you replace keeps who it was for.
knowledgeAgents.notUsedHere: This agent does not answer from this document.
